scientific_integrity: The infinite statement is proved algebraically from a four-unit antipodal-pair lemma, an exact 2-adic congruence criterion, and a parity-split classification. Exact cyclotomic enumeration for orders 8, 16, and 32 is corroborative rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for coefficient-one indicators of four-element subsets of cyclic groups of dyadic order. It does not cover arbitrary four-sparse coefficients, larger supports, noncyclic 2-groups, or cyclic orders with odd factors.
title: Dyadic shell classification of Fourier zeros for four-point indicators
